title: The Skills JSON schema
description: Skills is a specification for serving Agent Skills over MCP (io.modelcontextprotocol/skills extension).

name.title: The name of Service these skills relate to.

version.title: The version of API these skills relate to.

skills.title: The Service skills.
skills.description: The skills are defined with the skill name as key. The name must match the 'name' of the SKILL.md frontmatter.

skillItem.title: One skill definition
skillItem.description: A skill directory hosted on an HTTP(S) server. The gateway fetches SKILL.md and the declared files and serves them over MCP.

remoteContent.title: The remote HTTP(S) URL of the skill directory (the one holding SKILL.md).

path.title: Optional organizational prefix of the skill URI, without leading or trailing slash (e.g. 'acme/billing').

files.title: Supporting files of the skill, as paths relative to the skill directory (SKILL.md is implicit).

_meta.title: Optional metadata attached to the SKILL.md resource.
